cohort: Children 0-59 months admitted to the Dhaka Hospital of the International Centre for Diarrhoeal Disease Research, Bangladesh during two distinct time periods: March 2019-February 2020 (pre-COVID-19) and March 2020-February 2021 (COVID-19).
finding: Children admitted during the COVID-19 pandemic presented with more severe illness, including dehydration, sepsis, and convulsions, and infants born during the pandemic experienced higher rates of stunting, wasting, and risk of death compared to the pre-COVID-19 period.
followup_time: 6 months (for infants born during the pandemic related to stunting, wasting, and risk of death)
